news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.8% average weekly change). Market cap is less than US$100m (₹5.57b market cap, or US$59.2m).

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price gain to ₹44.10, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 10.6x. Average trailing P/E is 16x in the Shipping industry in India.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.29 (vs ₹1.56 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.29 (down from ₹1.56 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.45b (down 43% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹27.0m (down 78% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.9% (down from 4.9% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.54 (vs ₹1.56 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.54 (down from ₹1.56 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.15b (down 15% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹123.6m (flat on 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.7% (up from 4.9% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses.
